title: LessonScript
description: The structured two-voice podcast script. This is the boundary artifact between the Lesson Generator (batch) and the Player/web app; both communicate through this schema, not shared internal state (Constitution: subsystem independence). Stored as lessons.script (jsonb).

version.description: Schema/format version of this script document.

speakers.description: The two personas. Teacher voiceId is pinned in config and reused by the live tutor (Constitution I voice consistency).

segments.description: Ordered dialogue turns. Rendered per-segment under the TTS char limit, then stitched (research R5).

coverage.description: Item -> segment map proving every accepted teachable item is taught at least once (FR-009/SC-002). Validated in code before status flips to ready (research R2).

estimatedDurationSeconds.description: Length budget estimate at script time (~300-600s target, FR-012).

voiceId.description: ElevenLabs voice ID. Teacher voiceId is fixed across scripted + live (Constitution I).

id.description: Stable segment identifier referenced by coverage entries.

text.description: Spoken line. Combined per-request payload must stay under the TTS ~3000-char limit (research R5).

audioTags.description: Expressiveness cues for Text to Dialogue (e.g. warm, curious, emphatic) so output sounds told, not read (Constitution I).

normalizedText.description: The taught item, for human-readable verification.

segmentIds.description: Segments that teach this item; MUST be non-empty for every accepted item (FR-009).
